title: Listening Drill — Community choir archive — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Community choir archive — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on community choir archive last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with repeated recordings. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: missing label.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of recording date so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow index cards instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the archive coordinator before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Tuesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
